usedFor: Kajabi sells your courses and offers, and Microsoft Excel records each “New Purchased” through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchased” in Kajabi, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every offer purchase adds a row, so sales by offer can be totalled in a table.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” needs an existing Excel table, so set it up before the first “New Purchased” runs.
